verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows indirect batch-style behavior: evaluations run scorers across a whole Dataset of examples, and Threads let you score an entire conversation rather than individual calls. Signals automatically classify agent interactions at scale, and a REST Service API allows programmatic access that could be scripted across many items. None of this is documented as a bulk-operations feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk actions on traces/calls/datasets (e.g., bulk delete, tag, annotate, or export), documented batch endpoints in the Service API, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
